name: OPNsense Hardening
summary: The firewall's own security events: web interface logins and brute force, configuration changes and who made them, firmware and power actions, VPN and IPsec authentication, CARP and gateway state, CrowdSec decisions.
summary_zh: 防火牆本身的資安事件：網頁介面登入與暴力破解、設定變更與變更者、韌體與電源操作、VPN 與 IPsec 認證、CARP 與閘道狀態、CrowdSec 決策。
notes: OPNsense writes its audit trail (web interface logins, failed logins, configuration changes, firmware actions) under the syslog name "audit". Wazuh decodes that name as Solaris BSM and drops it at rule 6100, level 0, so none of it ever alerted: measured on two firewalls, 549 audit lines in 30 days and no alert. This pack's decoders are children of that decoder, built from the format strings in the OPNsense source, and every rule was tested against real lines from those two firewalls where they exist.

Web interface: a successful login is recorded, not alerted (level 2), with no site list needed. It alerts when the account is the built-in superuser root (level 3), the first time an account logs in from an address on a firewall (level 3), from an address outside the private ranges (level 5, root level 8), and right after six failed logins from the same address (level 12). A failed login is level 5, six from one address in two minutes level 10. Logouts and expired sessions are recorded. Requests for pages without a session (stale browser tabs, scanners; measured 37 a month per firewall from an nmap probe) are recorded, and twenty in a minute from one address are level 6.

Configuration changes: every save names the account, its address, the page and the backup file that holds the new version. A change through the web interface or the API is level 5; accounts, privileges and authentication servers, administrative access settings, and a restored or reverted configuration are level 7. Changes saved by local processes (migrations, plugin scripts; a few a week) are level 3, from the console menu level 5, and a root password reset from the console level 7. On an HA backup the changes pushed by the primary are level 3.

Firmware and power: a firmware update, upgrade or package install from the web interface is level 5 and names the person; reboot and power off level 5. Through configd: a scheduled automatic update and a reboot or halt are level 5, flushing the configuration history level 5, a factory reset level 10. Package upgrades are recorded below the alert level (136 lines in one measured update); a package installed, removed or downgraded is level 3.

Logins through OPNsense's own authentication for services other than the web interface (SSH with a password, the console, IPsec users) carry no address. They are recorded (level 2); root (level 3) and the first login of an account on a firewall (level 3) alert, a failure is level 5, eight failures for one account in two minutes level 10, and a login right after them level 12. Measured: a configuration backup account logging in every hour made 191 level 3 alerts a month per firewall; now it makes one, the first time. Listing such accounts in etc/lists/jt-opnsense-service-accounts is optional tuning that silences even that one; their failures still alert.

OpenVPN: the built-in rules 81803 and 81804 call every TLS timeout a certificate failure or a possibly revoked user. Measured: 196 such alerts in a week from one phone on a bad network and no real failure. On OPNsense's OpenVPN instances a timed-out handshake is now recorded below the alert level, and thirty from one address in half an hour are level 5. A wrong user name or password is level 5 with the client address, six from one address in five minutes level 10; refusals by OPNsense's password check are level 5, a successful authentication is recorded (level 2; the built-in 81801 still shows the connection at level 3), a rejected certificate level 5 and a revoked one level 7. Other OpenVPN servers keep the built-in behaviour.

IPsec (strongSwan): a tunnel up is level 3, closed is recorded, an authentication failure (pre-shared key, certificate, XAuth, RADIUS, EAP) level 5, eight on one connection in five minutes level 10, a remote-access user login is recorded and its first login on a firewall level 3, a peer that stopped answering level 5. IKE requests from addresses that are not configured peers are recorded, and ten from one address in ten minutes are level 6. Built from the strongSwan source; the measured firewalls run no IPsec.

Gateways and high availability: dpinger exits on every gateway reconfiguration and the built-in rule 1004 read that as syslogd stopping (25 false level 5 alerts in three months on one firewall); it is now level 0. A gateway going down is level 5, other gateway alarms level 3. A CARP address becoming MASTER is level 7, BACKUP or INIT level 5, a demotion change level 4.

CrowdSec decisions are level 5 (the address is already blocked by CrowdSec), simulated ones level 3, a fatal CrowdSec error level 7. Rootcheck's "Files hidden inside directory" for /boot/efi, which is a FAT partition without link counts, is dropped (measured: 56 level 7 alerts a week on one firewall). The plugin's own active response is visible: an address added to its block list is level 3.

Firewall log (filterlog) is not changed. A single block is built-in rule 87701, level 5 with no_log, so it is counted but never stored, and only 87702 (18 blocks from one source in 45 seconds, level 10) alerts. That is deliberate: an internet-facing firewall blocks hundreds of thousands of packets a day (measured: 930,000 filterlog lines a day on one firewall) and a single block says nothing. Tick filter (filterlog) in the plugin only if 87702 is wanted, and expect that load on the agent and the manager.

What does not reach Wazuh through the plugin: it selects syslog programs, not facilities, so sshd (auth facility), API key failures (program api) and OPNsense's login protection (lockout_handler) cannot be selected. Key-based SSH logins leave no trace at all. The pack has rules for the API and login protection lines; they fire only if the firewall also sends syslog to the manager.

Prerequisites: OPNsense with the os-wazuh-agent plugin (1.3 tested), which writes the selected programs to /var/ossec/logs/opnsense_syslog.log in BSD syslog format. OPNsense's own log files under /var/log use RFC 5424, which Wazuh does not decode, so the plugin's file is the only usable source.
notes_zh: OPNsense 把稽核軌跡（網頁介面登入、登入失敗、設定變更、韌體操作）寫在 syslog 名稱「audit」底下。Wazuh 把這個名稱當成 Solaris BSM 解碼，並在規則 6100（level 0）丟掉，所以從來沒有告警過：實測兩台防火牆 30 天有 549 行稽核記錄、零筆告警。本套件的解碼器是那個解碼器的子解碼器，依 OPNsense 原始碼的格式字串撰寫；有真實記錄的情境，都用這兩台防火牆的真實記錄測過。

網頁介面：登入成功只記錄、不告警（level 2），不需要任何站台清單。以下情況才告警：帳號是內建超級使用者 root（level 3）、某帳號第一次從某位址登入某台防火牆（level 3）、來自私有網段以外的位址（level 5，root 為 level 8）、同一位址剛失敗六次後登入成功（level 12）。登入失敗為 level 5，同一位址兩分鐘內六次 level 10。登出與工作階段逾時會記錄。沒有工作階段就要求頁面（過期的瀏覽器分頁、掃描器；實測每台每月 37 筆來自 nmap 探測）會記錄，同一位址一分鐘內 20 次為 level 6。
設定變更：每次儲存都會記下帳號、來源位址、頁面，以及保存新版本的備份檔。透過網頁介面或 API 的變更為 level 5；帳號、權限與認證伺服器、管理存取設定、還原或回復設定為 level 7。本機程序（移轉、外掛程式腳本；每週數筆）儲存的變更為 level 3，從主控台選單變更為 level 5，從主控台重設 root 密碼為 level 7。HA 備援機收到主機推送的變更為 level 3。
韌體與電源：從網頁介面更新、升級韌體或安裝套件為 level 5，並記下操作者；重新開機與關機 level 5。經由 configd：排程自動更新、重新開機或停機為 level 5，清除設定歷程 level 5，回復原廠設定 level 10。套件升級記錄在告警等級之下（實測一次更新 136 行）；新增、移除或降版套件為 level 3。

網頁介面以外、透過 OPNsense 本身認證的登入（以密碼登入 SSH、主控台、IPsec 使用者）沒有來源位址。它們只記錄（level 2）；root（level 3）與某帳號第一次登入某台防火牆（level 3）會告警，失敗為 level 5，同一帳號兩分鐘內失敗八次 level 10，緊接著登入成功 level 12。實測一個每小時登入的設定備份帳號每台每月產生 191 筆 level 3；現在只有第一次的一筆。把這類帳號列入 etc/lists/jt-opnsense-service-accounts 是選用的調校，連那一筆也會靜音；失敗仍會告警。

OpenVPN：內建規則 81803 與 81804 把每一次 TLS 逾時都當成憑證失敗或「可能是已撤銷的使用者」。實測一支網路不穩的手機一週產生 196 筆，沒有一筆是真正的認證失敗。在 OPNsense 的 OpenVPN 執行個體上，逾時的交握現在記錄在告警等級之下，同一位址半小時內 30 次為 level 5。帳號或密碼錯誤為 level 5 並附來源位址，同一位址五分鐘內六次 level 10；OPNsense 密碼檢查拒絕為 level 5，認證成功只記錄（level 2；內建 81801 仍以 level 3 顯示連線），憑證被拒 level 5，已撤銷的憑證 level 7。其他 OpenVPN 伺服器維持內建行為。

IPsec（strongSwan）：通道建立為 level 3，關閉會記錄，認證失敗（預共享金鑰、憑證、XAuth、RADIUS、EAP）level 5，同一連線五分鐘內八次 level 10，遠端存取使用者登入只記錄，第一次登入某台防火牆為 level 3，對端不再回應 level 5。來自非設定對端的 IKE 請求會記錄，同一位址十分鐘內十次為 level 6。依 strongSwan 原始碼撰寫；實測的防火牆沒有使用 IPsec。
閘道與高可用：dpinger 每次重新設定閘道都會結束，內建規則 1004 把它當成 syslogd 停止（實測一台三個月 25 筆 level 5 誤報），現在為 level 0。閘道斷線為 level 5，其他閘道警示 level 3。CARP 位址成為 MASTER 為 level 7，變成 BACKUP 或 INIT 為 level 5，降級值變更為 level 4。

CrowdSec 的決策為 level 5（該位址 CrowdSec 已經封鎖），模擬決策 level 3，CrowdSec 嚴重錯誤 level 7。Rootcheck 對 /boot/efi 回報的「Files hidden inside directory」會被丟掉，那是沒有連結數的 FAT 分割區（實測一台每週 56 筆 level 7）。外掛程式本身的主動回應也看得到：位址被加入封鎖清單為 level 3。

防火牆記錄（filterlog）不做更動。單一封鎖是內建規則 87701，level 5 且 no_log，只計數、從不儲存，只有 87702（同一來源 45 秒內 18 次封鎖，level 10）會告警。這是刻意的：面向網際網路的防火牆每天封鎖數十萬個封包（實測一台每天 930,000 行 filterlog），單一封鎖沒有資訊。只有需要 87702 時才在外掛程式勾選 filter（filterlog），並預期 agent 與 manager 的負載。
透過外掛程式送不到 Wazuh 的：外掛程式選的是 syslog 程式而不是 facility，所以 sshd（auth facility）、API 金鑰失敗（程式 api）與 OPNsense 的登入保護（lockout_handler）都無法勾選。以金鑰登入 SSH 完全不留痕跡。本套件仍有 API 與登入保護的規則，只有在防火牆另外把 syslog 送到 manager 時才會觸發。
前提：OPNsense 安裝 os-wazuh-agent 外掛程式（測試版本 1.3），它會把勾選的程式以 BSD syslog 格式寫進 /var/ossec/logs/opnsense_syslog.log。OPNsense 自己在 /var/log 下的記錄檔是 RFC 5424 格式，Wazuh 無法解碼，所以外掛程式的檔案是唯一可用的來源。
author: Jason Tools

agent_group.name: opnsense
agent_group.description: OPNsense firewalls with the os-wazuh-agent plugin: adds the CrowdSec log, which is a file of its own outside syslog

setup.title: Install the pack and reload the ruleset on every node
setup.title_zh: 安裝套件並在所有節點重新載入規則集
setup.body: Install from this page, then use Reload Ruleset on the Rules tab. A cluster synchronises rule files but does not reload the workers.
setup.body_zh: 在本頁安裝後，到「規則」分頁按「重新載入規則集」。叢集只同步規則檔、不會重載 worker。

setup.title: Define the opnsense-fw command on every manager node (for the active responses)
setup.title_zh: 在每個 manager 節點定義 opnsense-fw 指令（主動回應需要）
setup.body: The active responses of this pack use the os-wazuh-agent plugin's own script, which the plugin installs on the firewall as /var/ossec/active-response/bin/opnsense-fw (it adds the address to the alias __wazuh_agent_drop and removes it again when the timeout expires, so timeout_allowed must be yes). Wazuh does not define that command by default: paste the block into ossec.conf on every manager node, inside <ossec_config>, and restart the manager or reload its configuration. The response only works on agents that have the script, that is OPNsense firewalls with the plugin and its Active response setting enabled (the default); on any other agent the command fails and nothing is blocked. Nothing is blocked until a response is switched on in this pack.
setup.body_zh: 本套件的主動回應使用 os-wazuh-agent 外掛程式自己的腳本，外掛程式把它安裝在防火牆的 /var/ossec/active-response/bin/opnsense-fw（它把位址加入 __wazuh_agent_drop 別名，逾時後再移除，所以 timeout_allowed 必須是 yes）。Wazuh 預設沒有定義這個指令：請把下列區塊貼進每個 manager 節點 ossec.conf 的 <ossec_config> 內，然後重新啟動 manager 或重新載入設定。這個回應只在有該腳本的 agent 上有效，也就是安裝了外掛程式、且其 Active response 設定已啟用（預設）的 OPNsense 防火牆；在其他 agent 上指令會失敗，什麼都不會被封鎖。在本套件中開啟回應之前，不會封鎖任何東西。
setup.verify: Before enabling a response, check that every node has the block: grep -A3 '<name>opnsense-fw</name>' /var/ossec/etc/ossec.conf
setup.verify_zh: 開啟回應之前，確認每個節點都有這個區塊：grep -A3 '<name>opnsense-fw</name>' /var/ossec/etc/ossec.conf

setup.title: Select the applications the plugin forwards (OPNsense web interface)
setup.title_zh: 選擇外掛程式要轉送的應用程式（OPNsense 網頁介面）
setup.body: On each firewall: Services > Wazuh Agent > Settings, field Applications. Tick audit (audit), configd (configd.py), kernel (kernel), pkg (pkg) and pkg (pkg-static), gateways (dpinger), openvpn (openvpn) if OpenVPN is used, ipsec (charon) if IPsec is used. filter (filterlog) only if the multiple-blocks alert 87702 is wanted: it is by far the largest source (measured 930,000 lines a day on one firewall). Then Apply. The plugin rewrites its syslog-ng filter and restarts the agent: the agent reconnects within seconds and traffic is not affected. Expected extra volume, measured: audit about 30 lines a day, configd from 400 to 50,000 lines a day (nearly all level 0), OpenVPN about 4,400 a day (a status poll every minute, level 0).
setup.body_zh: 每台防火牆：Services > Wazuh Agent > Settings 的 Applications 欄位。勾選 audit (audit)、configd (configd.py)、kernel (kernel)、pkg (pkg) 與 pkg (pkg-static)、gateways (dpinger)，有用 OpenVPN 時勾 openvpn (openvpn)，有用 IPsec 時勾 ipsec (charon)。只有需要多次封鎖告警 87702 時才勾 filter (filterlog)：它是最大的來源（實測一台每天 930,000 行）。然後按 Apply。外掛程式會改寫 syslog-ng 篩選並重新啟動 agent：agent 幾秒內重新連線，不影響流量。實測增加的量：audit 每天約 30 行，configd 每天 400 到 50,000 行（幾乎都是 level 0），OpenVPN 每天約 4,400 行（每分鐘一次狀態查詢，level 0）。
setup.verify: Log in to the web interface. Expect rule 131501 (level 3) for the firewall's agent on the manager.
setup.verify_zh: 登入網頁介面，manager 端該防火牆的 agent 應出現規則 131501（level 3）。

setup.title: Assign the firewalls to the opnsense group (CrowdSec)
setup.title_zh: 把防火牆加入 opnsense 群組（CrowdSec）
setup.body: Needed only on firewalls running os-crowdsec: the group adds CrowdSec's own log file, keeping decisions, the overflows behind them and fatal errors. Nothing else in the pack depends on the group.
setup.body_zh: 只有執行 os-crowdsec 的防火牆需要：群組會加上 CrowdSec 自己的記錄檔，只保留決策、觸發決策的事件與嚴重錯誤。套件其他部分不依賴這個群組。
setup.verify: After CrowdSec's next decision, expect rule 131591 (level 5).
setup.verify_zh: CrowdSec 下一次做出決策後，應出現規則 131591（level 5）。

setup.title: Optional: list accounts that log in for backups or monitoring
setup.title_zh: 選用：列出用於備份或監控而定期登入的帳號
setup.body: Not needed for a quiet default: such logins are already recorded below the alert level after the first one. Listing an account (one OPNsense user name per line, then reload the ruleset) also silences that first alert and root-level alerts for it. Its failures still alert.
setup.body_zh: 預設已經安靜，不需要這一步：這類登入在第一次之後就只記錄、不告警。列入清單（每行一個 OPNsense 使用者名稱，然後重新載入規則集）會連第一次的告警也靜音。失敗仍會告警。

setup.title: Keep successful web interface logins in the log
setup.title_zh: 保留網頁介面登入成功的記錄
setup.body: If System > Settings > Administration > "Disable logging of web GUI successful logins" is ticked, OPNsense does not write the line with the client address, and rules 131501 and 131504 cannot fire. The account still appears at level 2 (131506).
setup.body_zh: 若勾選了 System > Settings > Administration 的「Disable logging of web GUI successful logins」，OPNsense 不會寫出帶有來源位址的那一行，規則 131501 與 131504 無法觸發。帳號仍會以 level 2 出現（131506）。

setup.title: Also send syslog to the manager for sshd, API keys and login protection
setup.title_zh: 另外把 syslog 送到 manager，取得 sshd、API 金鑰與登入保護
setup.body: The plugin cannot select these. To get them: System > Settings > Logging > Remote, add a destination pointing at the manager's syslog port (the manager needs a <remote> syslog section that allows the firewall's address), transport UDP, RFC 5424 unticked, facilities auth (sshd) and local4 (API key messages). OPNsense's login protection (lockout_handler) logs under the user facility, which carries much more; add it only if that volume is acceptable. The events then arrive at the manager itself with the firewall's address as location, so the built-in sshd rules, 131517-131519 and 131555 apply; an active response for them must name the firewall's agent (defined-agent).
setup.body_zh: 外掛程式無法選取這些。要取得時：System > Settings > Logging > Remote 新增一個目的地，指向 manager 的 syslog 連接埠（manager 需要有允許該防火牆位址的 <remote> syslog 區段），傳輸 UDP，不勾 RFC 5424，facility 選 auth（sshd）與 local4（API 金鑰訊息）。OPNsense 的登入保護（lockout_handler）寫在 user facility，那裡的量大得多；能接受時再加上。事件會送到 manager 本身、以防火牆位址為 location，因此內建 sshd 規則、131517-131519 與 131555 會套用；針對它們的主動回應必須指定防火牆的 agent（defined-agent）。

active_response.title: Block an address that keeps failing to log in to the web interface, on the firewall itself
active_response.title_zh: 在防火牆本身封鎖一再登入網頁介面失敗的位址
active_response.body: Runs the os-wazuh-agent plugin's opnsense-fw script on the firewall that was attacked: the address is added to the alias __wazuh_agent_drop, which a block rule on every interface uses, and its open connections are killed, for 10 minutes. Needs Active response enabled in the plugin (on by default) and the opnsense-fw command defined on the manager (name opnsense-fw, executable opnsense-fw, timeout allowed). It only stops traffic that passes through the firewall: hosts on the attacker's own network segment are not protected. Risk: the address loses everything the firewall routes for it, not only the web interface. An administrator who mistypes six times locks out their workstation, and every user behind the same NAT address with them. Add administrator, monitoring and backup addresses to the manager's <global><white_list> first (the manager never sends a block for those), and exclude whole management networks with the plugin's Firewall command ignore alias.
active_response.body_zh: 在被攻擊的防火牆上執行 os-wazuh-agent 外掛程式的 opnsense-fw 腳本：把位址加入 __wazuh_agent_drop 別名（所有介面上都有一條封鎖規則使用它），並中斷它現有的連線，為期 10 分鐘。需要外掛程式啟用 Active response（預設開啟），並在 manager 定義 opnsense-fw 指令（名稱 opnsense-fw、執行檔 opnsense-fw、允許逾時）。它只擋得住經過防火牆的流量：與攻擊者在同一網段的主機不受保護。風險：該位址會失去防火牆替它轉送的一切，不只是網頁介面。打錯密碼六次的管理者會讓自己的工作站斷線，同一 NAT 位址後的所有使用者也一樣。請先把管理者、監控與備份主機的位址加入 manager 的 <global><white_list>（manager 不會對這些位址送出封鎖），並以外掛程式的 Firewall command ignore 別名排除整個管理網段。

active_response.title: Block an address that keeps failing to log in to OpenVPN
active_response.title_zh: 封鎖一再登入 OpenVPN 失敗的位址
active_response.body: Same mechanism as above, after six wrong user names or passwords from one address in five minutes. The address is usually on the internet, so blocking it at the edge is where it belongs. Risk: a mobile carrier's NAT address shared by many subscribers, or a hotel network, is blocked for every user behind it for 10 minutes, including your own staff there. Add administrator, monitoring and backup addresses to the manager's <global><white_list> first (the manager never sends a block for those), and exclude whole management networks with the plugin's Firewall command ignore alias.
active_response.body_zh: 機制同上，在同一位址五分鐘內六次帳號或密碼錯誤後觸發。這類位址通常在網際網路上，在邊界封鎖正是適當的位置。風險：行動業者由許多使用者共用的 NAT 位址或飯店網路，會讓其後的所有使用者被封鎖 10 分鐘，包括身在那裡的自家員工。請先把管理者、監控與備份主機的位址加入 manager 的 <global><white_list>（manager 不會對這些位址送出封鎖），並以外掛程式的 Firewall command ignore 別名排除整個管理網段。

active_response.title: Block scanners at the edge: repeated firewall blocks, web interface scans, IKE probing
active_response.title_zh: 在邊界封鎖掃描者：多次防火牆封鎖、網頁介面掃描、IKE 探測
active_response.body: Blocks the source of the built-in 87702 (18 blocked packets from one source in 45 seconds), a web interface scan (131514) or repeated IKE requests from a non-peer (131588) for an hour, on every port: a scanner that hits closed ports first is kept away from the open ones too. It only helps for traffic that crosses the firewall. Risk: a wrong match blocks a whole site. A partner, a monitoring service or a CDN address that keeps hitting a blocked port, or an internal inventory scanner (87702 counts LAN-side blocks as well), loses all access through the firewall for an hour. Add administrator, monitoring and backup addresses to the manager's <global><white_list> first (the manager never sends a block for those), and exclude whole management networks with the plugin's Firewall command ignore alias. Known internal scanners and partners belong in that list too.
active_response.body_zh: 對內建 87702（同一來源 45 秒內 18 個被擋封包）、網頁介面掃描（131514）或非對端一再送出的 IKE 請求（131588）的來源，在所有連接埠封鎖一小時：先掃關閉連接埠的掃描者，也會被擋在開放的連接埠之外。只對經過防火牆的流量有效。風險：誤判會封鎖整個站點。一再碰到被擋連接埠的合作夥伴、監控服務或 CDN 位址，或內部的資產盤點掃描器（87702 也計算 LAN 端的封鎖），會在一小時內失去經過防火牆的所有存取。請先把管理者、監控與備份主機的位址加入 manager 的 <global><white_list>（manager 不會對這些位址送出封鎖），並以外掛程式的 Firewall command ignore 別名排除整個管理網段。已知的內部掃描器與合作夥伴也應列入。
